text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are we really going there?! That<n>French
restaurant is super famous!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What, is it too fancy for you? I could<n>make a
reservation elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, that's definitely not at all what I<n>mean! It's only,
well...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm kind of worried I'll make a<n>mistake with my
table manners...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Now this is new... You're<n>normally so gung ho
with everything.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But, King, this time I'll be dining withyou. What if I embarrass myself...Aaagh!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, we'll just have to take our<n>chances. And while
we're eating, I'll<n>hammer some proper manners
into<n>that thick head of yours.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry. Just have a first-rate<n>celebration
and enjoy yourself.<n>Happy birthday, Kawakami.
